comparator.name: Econometrics and Operations Research
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official programme totals 180 ECTS. Years 1 and 2 each contain 60 ECTS of mathematics, statistics, economics, econometrics, operations research, programming and development work. Year 3 contains a 30-ECTS mobility or elective window, 12 ECTS of philosophy and ethics, one 6-ECTS compulsory elective and a 12-ECTS thesis. Zero-credit GROW and software-workshop activities are excluded. The 30-ECTS mobility window and the 6-ECTS compulsory elective remain genuine choice space rather than being filled with assumed courses.

progressionAssessment.rationale: Programming, economics and corporate-finance foundations begin in Semester 1. Mathematical Methods, Research Methods and introductory data science precede the mathematics, statistics, econometrics and advanced data work. Algorithms & Data Structures precedes Advanced Algorithms; optimisation follows programming and the main mathematical foundations, while reinforcement learning is reserved for the final semester after programming and machine learning. Every formal prerequisite occurs earlier and every course is offered in its assigned term.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest curriculum supports broad quantitative economics, econometrics and optimisation. Business analytics/data science and quantitative finance each support coherent, mechanically feasible and substantively distinct additional programmes. Actuarial science was assessed separately but rejected because UCR lacks a sufficient dedicated insurance and life-contingencies sequence. Three alternatives are included, the maximum.
